Completionist Cape is an achievement that requires the player to complete all the following achievements, enabling the player to obtain the completionist cape. The completionist cape can still be claimed if the only remaining (indirect) achievements have an active grace period.

This also unlocks the title [Name] the Completionist.

This information has been compiled as part of the update history project. Some updates may not be included – see here for how to help out!
  • patch 23 March 2026 (Update):
    • Made the following requirement changes to the Completionist Cape:
      • Added 'No Need to Pikkenchoose'
      • Added 'Maximum Poolpulation'
      • Added 'It Should Have Been Called Chinskin'
  • patch 17 April 2023 (Update):
    • Made the following requirement changes to the Completionist Cape:
      • Removed 'A Druid's Sidekick'
      • Added 'Balanced Combat Triangle'
      • Added 'Gaps, Traps and Laps'
      • Added 'Slide To The Left'
      • Added 'Towering Over Us All'
      • Added 'Untangled'
      • Added 'Power Planter II' (New - unlock 'Plant Power (Tier 4)' in the Garden of Kharid)
      • Added 'Tiers of Treasure' (New - complete one of every tier of Clue Scroll)
  • patch 12 October 2020 (Update):
    • Players will no longer receive the Music Maestro and Completionist achievements every time they log in.
  • update 18 April 2017 (Update):
    • Added to game.
